title: Cancellation Charge Schedule by Billing Payment Record (Cardinal Personal Auto Policy)
content:
On a cancellation of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy at the named insured's request, the cancellation charge follows the payment record of the policy's Cardinal Billing Account. Two things are read from that account: its automatic-payment enrollment, and the returned payments posted to its ledger in the last twelve months.

## Charge matrix

| Automatic payments | Returned payments posted in the last twelve months | Cancellation charge |
|---|---|---|
| Enrolled | None | No charge (0.00) |
| Not enrolled | None | Half (0.5) of the package's cancellation fee |
| Enrolled | One or more | The package's cancellation fee |
| Not enrolled | One or more | The package's cancellation fee |

## The package's cancellation fee and the resulting charge

| Package | Package's cancellation fee, USD | Enrolled, none returned | Not enrolled, none returned | Any returned payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Auto Essential | 50.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Basic | 50.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Standard | 25.00 | 0.00 | 12.50 | 25.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Plus | 25.00 | 0.00 | 12.50 | 25.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Preferred | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cardinal Auto Premier | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Notes

- The twelve months run back from the day the cancellation is worked out. A returned payment posted thirteen months earlier is outside them; one posted eleven months earlier is inside.
- Enrollment is read as it stands on the Cardinal Billing Account record.
